task: Add milk, eggs and bread to my Tesco basket

nodes.do: On tesco.ie search for milk, eggs and bread. For each, pick the default item (see the tesco skill) and note its name and price.
Add each chosen item to the basket once.
nodes.undo: Empty the basket (see the tesco skill).

nodes.do: Open the basket and confirm it holds exactly the 3 items (milk, eggs, bread) with quantity 1 each. Read the basket total.
Ask: Tesco basket, total is <TOTAL>. Do I pay? Do not open the payment page. Empty the basket after the answer.
